lines.text: her phone kept buzzing on the marble floor. i picked it up. i should have let it ring some more.

lines.speaker: countess
lines.text: "one bag back? how cute. i keep a few thousand more. come up to the roof, little one. let's settle the score."
the stairs went on past where the building should end. the storm was waiting at the top, like an old friend.
a helicopter hung in the rain with its light on the door. it didn't blink. it had seen men like me before.

lines.speaker: goon_a
lines.text: "he really came! the countess said he would."

lines.speaker: goon_b
lines.text: "i said he'd come. i never said he was good."
nothing above me now but the weather and the fall. i'd come up here for one bag. now i wanted it all.
